Reviews from 2024–2026 stay positive, praising cleanliness, decor, quiet surroundings, easy parking, the small back patio, and Christal's responsive, helpful communication. It is repeatedly called ideal for one or two people. Recurring limitations: three recent reviews (2025–2026) say the listing did not make clear the studio shares walls with the main house, so sounds carried; a 2019 review likewise mentioned thin walls, barking, and loud music. Older, isolated reports include a 2021 ant problem plus unlockable windows and a smaller fridge than pictured, a bright neighboring light, no temperature control, and a lukewarm bathtub. These are guest reports, not verified current conditions.

system_b.summary: Guests widely praise this studio's walkable downtown location, cleanliness, comfortable cozy bed, artistic decor, easy check-in and parking, and responsive, hands-off hosting, with positive reports continuing into 2026. The most important concern is noise and layout: the unit shares walls with the host's main house. Three 2025–2026 reviews say the listing did not make this clear, and a 2019 guest reported thin walls, dogs and bass-heavy music, though that guest also said they slept fine. Other guests, including recent ones, found it quiet and peaceful, so experiences conflict and may depend on household activity. The similar wording of the recent reports does not confirm independence. Single 2021 reports mention unlockable TV-room windows, ants in the kitchen with a host response the guest found inadequate, and a broken parking pass. A 2023 guest described a neighborhood in transition. Smaller complaints from 2016–2021 are unverified today, and current conditions or listing wording are not confirmed.

selected_claims.claim: The studio shares walls with the host's main house, and sound carries between the spaces. Three reviews from 2025-2026 say the listing did not make this clear. One 2019 reviewer found the walls thin, heard dogs and bass-heavy music, and was unsure of the layout at booking. That same reviewer said noise was never a major issue and they slept fine. The 2019 report predates the 2025-2026 reports. Whether the current situation matches is not verified.
selected_claims.time_qualification: One report in 2019; three recent reports from 2025 to 2026 (the latest in February 2026)
selected_claims.uncertainty: Reviews are similarly worded, so they may not be fully independent. Severity varies by guest, and the ledger does not show whether the host has made changes.

selected_claims.claim: The listing was reported to be unclear that the unit is one side of the host's home. A 2019 guest said this was unclear at booking, and three 2025-2026 reviews say the listing did not make shared walls clear.
selected_claims.time_qualification: 2019 and 2025-2026; the recent reports are the more relevant
selected_claims.uncertainty: The current listing wording is not verified. Other guests said the place matched photos and description.

selected_claims.claim: Many guests across all years describe the space as quiet and peaceful, including some recent ones. Others noted the apartment is part of the main house but quiet.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Quietness experiences conflict with the shared-wall reports, and results likely depend on household activity at the time of the stay.

selected_claims.claim: One 2021 guest reported two TV-room windows that cannot be locked at all. This is a security concern.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No later mention either way, so the current state is unknown.

selected_claims.claim: The same 2021 guest reported ants throughout the kitchen within the first 12 hours, including in an unopened muffin package. The host replied in about 90 minutes and provided ant bait, but the guest said the issue was not disclosed and no reimbursement was offered.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Possibly seasonal or one-off; no later ant reports appear.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is praised in nearly every review across all years, including recent ones.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The ant report is a lone contrary account.

selected_claims.claim: Guests widely praise the location as walkable to downtown, with Whole Foods and other groceries very close. One 2023 reviewer described a neighborhood in transition with some properties needing work; they were not concerned but said others might be. Others felt comfortable or safe walking at night.
selected_claims.time_qualification: 2015-2026, consistent through 2026; the neighborhood caveat dates from 2023
selected_claims.uncertainty: Walking time varies by report, from 5 to about 20 minutes.

selected_claims.claim: The bed and furnishings are commonly described as comfortable and cozy, and the decor as artistic, with recent confirmation.

Smaller comfort and equipment complaints: a bright neighboring security light lit the bedroom at night (2016), the unit's temperature could not be adjusted and got warm (2020), the bathtub water was only lukewarm while the shower was hot (2020), a toilet seat would not stay up (2021), and a fridge smaller than pictured and a bed set up differently from photos (2021).
selected_claims.uncertainty: Each is a single report and current status is unknown.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is described as easy with clear instructions, and parking is easy (a free spot or pass). One 2021 guest said the parking pass was broken. A 2023 lockout was attributed to guest error, and the host helped quickly.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The broken pass is a single 2021 report.

selected_claims.claim: Hosting is widely described as responsive, helpful and hands-off, with local recommendations, and this is also confirmed in recent reviews. One 2021 guest was dissatisfied with the response to the ant problem.

selected_claims.claim: The unit is well equipped (kitchenette, coffee and tea, toiletries, streaming, a back patio or deck) and suits two people. Value is described as fair or a great deal in two reviews.
